SELECT a.id AS id, a.name AS name, a.model_area AS modelArea, a.remarks AS remarks, COALESCE(SUM(h.person_count), 0) AS totalPersonNumber, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(h.person_count), 0) / #{bucketCount}) AS avgPersonNumber, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(h2.person_count) AS peak_person_number FROM traffic_detection_area_device ad2 INNER JOIN traffic_detection_hourly_person_flow h2 ON h2.device_id = ad2.device_id AND h2.record_time >= #{begin} AND h2.record_time < #{end} WHERE ad2.traffic_detection_area_id = a.id GROUP BY CASE WHEN #{granularity} = 'MONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m') WHEN #{granularity} = 'DAY' THEN DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') END ORDER BY peak_person_number DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS peakPersonNumber, COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN #{granularity} = 'MONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m') WHEN #{granularity} = 'DAY' THEN DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(h2.record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') END AS peak_period FROM traffic_detection_area_device ad2 INNER JOIN traffic_detection_hourly_person_flow h2 ON h2.device_id = ad2.device_id AND h2.record_time >= #{begin} AND h2.record_time < #{end} WHERE ad2.traffic_detection_area_id = a.id GROUP BY peak_period ORDER BY SUM(h2.person_count) DESC LIMIT 1 ), #{defaultPeakPeriod}) AS peakPeriod FROM traffic_detection_area a LEFT JOIN traffic_detection_area_device ad ON ad.traffic_detection_area_id = a.id LEFT JOIN traffic_detection_hourly_person_flow h ON h.device_id = ad.device_id AND h.record_time >= #{begin} AND h.record_time < #{end} WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.id IN
#{areaId}
GROUP BY a.id, a.name, a.model_area, a.remarks ORDER BY
avgPersonNumber DESC,
totalPersonNumber DESC
